name: configuration
description: The Configuration pane of the kit's panes (a button on the band, /configuration): every mod's settings, for all computers or this one, with the value the other computers use, and a low power mode for everything that fetches by itself; the Do not disturb pane opens from it when dnd is installed.

lowPower.title: Low power mode
lowPower.description: Everything the kit fetches by itself (the dev activity pane and pr-watch, the reminders and handoffs, do not disturb) does it five times less often: on, off, or on battery (while the computer runs on its battery or in its low power mode). A refresh button still reads everything; the status line shows 🔋 low power while it is on.
